combo_label: Phones & Apps × Hot Air Balloons × The Moon Landings

entries.clue: Bright young crater in the south, its pale streaks reaching a thousand miles
Lowing beasts in a meadow, panicked by a roar from overhead
Frozen picture and a spinning circle while the video catches up
Mother craft of the first landing flight, bearing a poetic name for America
Woodwind held sideways, or a tall thin glass for a celebration
Name and number stored in a phone so you never learn it by heart
Detachable unit of a larger craft, whether command, service or landing
Of the wind, to swing round clockwise and change its bearing
Tinted outer shade hinged over the helmet against raw glare
Electronic messages that arrive at an address with an at sign
Climb high and hang there without a wingbeat, as an eagle does
Plug-in gadget that refills a flat handset overnight
